outcome: Keep stock and order status current across sales, warehouse and delivery systems using governed event streams.
overview: Keep stock and order updates consistent across retail applications, warehouses and delivery services. Start with one event domain and a small consumer set. Turkey has direct regional proof through Getir. India and Gulf opportunities require regional feature qualification and a measurable freshness requirement. [S2, S3]
kpi: P95 event-to-consumer lag and inventory freshness
scope: Planning estimate: four to six weeks for one event domain. Deliver an event map, schema catalogue, one producer, two consumer paths, lag dashboard and recovery runbook. Add rejection, retry and replay handling. Run a parallel path before cutover. Customer application owners accept behavior and rollback.
